Thanks to the whole crew

Comfort first on every route

The Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps the focus on calm handling and clear checks from curb to cabin. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and care plans should match each animal's species, temperament, and comfort. <<FACT F035>> Use the pet cabin as directed, confirm soft bedding and water access, and brief travelers on simple boarding steps before doors close.

On cloudbound services, steady coordination matters just as much. <<FACT F052>> Keep an eye on carrier fit, quiet loading, and clean handoffs so every pet settles well and every traveler feels informed. Aurelia Skyways will keep refining the process, and staff should continue using the same careful standards on each route.
